summary.text: Jared Sluss is the Democratic candidate for Alabama State Senate District 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Sam Givhan.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he listed education funding, infrastructure and health care access as his key messages.

paragraphs.text: Jared Sluss advanced to the general election after the Democratic primary for the seat was canceled.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he wants to fund local schools, pay teachers competitively and expand workforce development programs.
He also said he supports state investment in roads, public transit and high-speed internet, and expanding health care access, including Medicaid expansion.
